description: This file defines an Angular service 'ComponentDescriptorService' that manages retrieval and caching of component descriptors via HTTP requests, including methods for fetching by type, multiple types, and class name.

classes.name: ComponentDescriptorService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service for managing component descriptors, including fetching and caching logic.

methods.name: getComponentDescriptorsByType
methods.description: Fetches component descriptors by component type and rule chain type, with caching.

methods.name: getComponentDescriptorsByTypes
methods.description: Fetches multiple component descriptors by an array of component types and rule chain type, with caching.

methods.name: getComponentDescriptorByClazz
methods.description: Fetches a component descriptor by its class name, with caching.
